samples.title: Booking rack: Proof strip
samples.statement:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
drawers is a list of bookings. Each row is [start, end]. k is included in the function call, but this task does not use it. You can ignore it.

Step 1: Build the result list
Each booking is [start, end]. It uses time from start up to, but not including, end. Sort bookings by end time, from earliest to latest. For matching end times, put the earlier start first. Accept the first booking. Then accept a booking only if it starts at or after the end of the last one accepted. Record the length, end - start, of each accepted booking. Keep acceptance order. Negative times are allowed. With no bookings, the result list is empty.

Step 2: Return the answer
Return the whole result list in the order you built it. If it is empty, return [].

Write your function
Complete bookingRackProofStrip(drawers, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
